title: Scheduling and Availability
summary: Design a healthcare appointment platform where provider availability, blackout windows, waitlists, time zones, and database-level double-booking prevention are correct under concurrency.
critical_queries: Find provider availability for a local date range.
Book one appointment without double-booking under concurrent requests.
List upcoming bookings for a provider.
Cancel an appointment and promote the first waitlisted patient.
Find patients on a provider waitlist.
Search professionals by specialty and bio when FTS is implemented.
Explain why appointments are not partitioned yet.

security_posture.correctness: exclusion constraints prevent overlapping confirmed appointments
security_posture.timezone: stored timestamptz with provider timezone for rendering
security_posture.extensions: btree_gist allowed for GiST equality support; no PostGIS

operational_notes: Correctness under concurrent booking is more important than a clever scheduler. The design should explain lock behavior, error handling, time-zone rendering, and why geo and partitioning are not yet justified.
